thread:
sam (partnerships): Quick sync: marketplace SI partner asked for a one-page SEV playbook they can follow during business hours and a minimal mobile-friendly checklist for nights/weekends. Can we produce both?

paul (partner-success): They want clear entry points and a guaranteed ack window. Also prefer a single shared channel rather than multiple DMs.

leo (eng-sre): Proposed flow (concise): 1) Partner posts to #partner-<vendor>-sev (private) + tags @redwood-partner-oncall. 2) If response within 8m -> triage in-channel. 3) If SEV1 or no response -> escalate to @redwood-sre-oncall + open bridge; include incident header (see template).

meera (solutions): Add instructions for safe data sharing: scrub PII, include sample request-id, shortened logs link, and an anonymized prompt. Provide link to secure upload if they need to share payloads: https://files.redwood.example/secure-upload

sam (partnerships): Good. Also they asked who can toggle fallbacks: solutions vs partner-success. We should name roles: partner can request fallback, but only @solutions or @eng-sre can flip model/version in prod.

ops-bot: Note: creating #partner-<vendor>-sev requires partner consent and legal signoff. Use /legal-request form: https://legal.redwood.example/partner-channels

legal-bot: Partner consent received for incident channel; scope limited to telemetry and error traces (no raw PII).

leo (eng-sre): Here's a compact checklist and pasteable initial post (mobile friendly). Feel free to copy/paste into the marketplace docs.

```text
INITIAL POST (copy/paste):
SEV1: production 503s for tenant=<tenant_id> affecting endpoint=<endpoint>
Request samples: <request_id1>, <request_id2>
Model: <model_name> | Approx rate: <rps>
Please ack and join #partner-<vendor>-sev. Contact: @redwood-partner-oncall
```

meera (solutions): Also include an internal YAML ladder for our runbook so SREs/solutions can quickly follow the steps.

leo (eng-sre): YAML ladder (internal runbook):
```yaml
ladder:
  - name: partner-post
    action: "Partner posts to #partner-<vendor>-sev and pings @redwood-partner-oncall"
    timeout: "8m"
  - name: first-ack
    action: "If ack -> gather tenant_id, sample request_ids, model, logs URL, brief impact statement"
  - name: escalate-sre
    condition: "no ack OR SEV1"
    action: "Ping @redwood-sre-oncall, open bridge, assign incident lead"
  - name: cross-impact
    condition: "multiple tenants or marketplace outage"
    action: "Notify @eng-incident-comm and involve solutions + partner-success liaison"
  - name: compliance-path
    condition: "if data sensitivity suspected"
    action: "Invite security + legal immediately"
  - name: postmortem
    action: "Joint postmortem within 4 business days; owner: partner-success"
```

paul (partner-success): SLA ask: ack within 8m for SEV1 (oncall window) and 30m for SEV2. Mobile checklist for nights: if no ack in 20m -> email pager + open bridge. Add to docs?

meera (solutions): Yes, add the night flow and include the fallback model/version and how to request it (pre-approved versions only).

sam (partnerships): Ops tasks: 1) create the private channel after legal confirmation (legal-bot confirmed) 2) add webhook template to push summarized partner errors into channel (ops infra).

ops-bot: Created template request ticket: INFRA-5421. Suggested webhook payload: short summary, tenant hash, top 3 error samples with short IDs.

leo (eng-sre): I'll update internal runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.example/marketplace-si-sev and wire the webhook template.

sam (partnerships): Final deliverables: - One-page PDF for partner (mobile + desktop) - Internal YAML ladder + runbook link - Copy/paste initial post + mobile checklist - Walkthrough call with partner on Thurs 11am PT.

paul (partner-success): I'll send the PDF and schedule the walkthrough.

meera (solutions): I'll prepare a short demo of fallback toggle and what metrics to watch during the war room.

sam (partnerships): Thanks all. If no objections, we'll publish the one-pager to the marketplace listing and ship the internal runbook updates after the walkthrough. :shipit:
